annotations.title: Draft answers to a form's open questions

description: Draft the candidate's answers to an application form's open questions ("Why do you want to work here?", "Describe a project you led"), and only those (prepare_application answers every field), from their résumé, the notes they asked an agent to keep (for a connection that may read them) and the posting, one per question in order. Each answer lists what it rests on (context_note when it drew on a note), and needs_candidate marks one that needs a fact only they have. Self-identification, salary, visa, ID and password questions are never answered. Give the questions as the form prints them (up to 15) and exactly one of job_id, application_id, or job_description with company and role. An AI model writes them (Anthropic's Claude, with DeepSeek through OpenRouter as the fallback). It uses the candidate's monthly writing allowance. Give the answers to the candidate as written, to paste into the form.

instruction.description: The candidate's own steer, e.g. "mention my Kafka migration".

job_description.description: The posting's text, for a job outside the catalog.

job_id.description: An id from search_jobs or recommend_jobs.

questions.description: The open questions as the form prints them, up to 15.
